name: Dual Phase ~ Haramase Oyako
original_name: デュアルフェーズ ～孕ませ母娘
source:
Main character's lover gets pregnant one day, and at the same time he receives love confession from her mother, and after a sudden burst of lust she gets pregnant as well. Mother and daughter start to have the same symptoms, and secret gets revealed eventually.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-november-2007-demon.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一天，主人公的恋人友泽由梨绘怀孕了。与此同时，她的母亲律子突然向他告白；情欲骤然爆发后，律子竟也怀上了他的孩子。母女二人开始出现相同的妊娠反应，秘密最终还是暴露了。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-november-2007-demon.html]vndbreview[/url]]
